name: Forge zones
description: Kill, gravity and teleport zones, all in a Zones tab of the dev tools' menu (forge mode: F3, D-pad right or X): add a zone at the crosshair, choose its kind, setting (a teleport's channel number pairs it with the zones that have the same number) and size, move or remove it. Works with a keyboard and a controller. In a system link game the host places them, and they reach every machine.
